verdict.rationale: Lambda offers workload orchestration through Managed Slurm, where 'Slurm automatically schedules workloads' using standard Slurm tooling, and through Managed Kubernetes for deploying workloads. The REST Cloud API also lets users launch instances programmatically, so recurring runs could be built externally. However, the evidence only shows queue-based resource scheduling, not time-based recurring jobs or a native workflow scheduler. missing for 10: documented recurring/cron-style scheduling (e.g. scrontab or Kubernetes CronJobs), a native workflow or pipeline scheduler, scheduled instance start/stop via the API, and independent hands-on corroboration.
